title: Supported generation of ind-constructible modules
statement: Let Λ be any condensed commutative ring, X a qcqs scheme, and M an ordinary internal Λ_X-module that is a small filtered colimit of finite scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Then M[0] belongs to supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X [lem-sfb-supported-image-bounded-derived-generation]. The indexing universe is u+1 and the hull is the specified ordinary uncompleted hull, including strict filtered complex colimits with a common termwise lower bound. No Noetherianity or coefficient restriction is required.
